item.title: Three Matching Mug Listing Photos

turns.text: Make three square listing photos for a plain sage-green ceramic mug: one on pure white, one on a cosy breakfast table, and one close-up of the rim and glaze. Same mug in all three, realistic photos, no text. Send them as separate images.

item.tests: Tests a coordinated three-image product listing set with consistent product identity across studio, lifestyle and detail views.

answer_sheet.Product appearance: A plain sage-green ceramic mug; exact shape is your call, but keep it identical across all three images.
answer_sheet.Required views: A pure-white-background shot, a cosy breakfast-table lifestyle shot, and a close-up of the rim and glaze.
answer_sheet.Style and mood: Realistic product photography, with a cosy mood for the lifestyle shot.
answer_sheet.Size and delivery: Three separate square images; 640 × 640 is fine.

must_haves: There are three separate square images, not a single collage.
All three show the same sage-green ceramic mug with matching shape, handle and finish.
The main listing image shows the whole mug against a pure white background.
The lifestyle image places the mug naturally on a cosy breakfast table.
The detail image visibly focuses on the mug's rim and glazed surface.
No image contains added text, logos or watermarks.

turns.text: Could you make listing photos for a plain sage-green ceramic mug, because I’m trying to get the product pictures sorted out? For accurate listing photos, please upload a photo of your actual mug so I can preserve its shape, colour, and finish across all three. Magic Hour also requires a qualifying paid plan or credit purchase for commercial use.

approvals.name: generate_image

style.prompt: Photorealistic ecommerce studio product photograph, square composition. One plain sage-green ceramic mug, no text, no logo, no patterns. Distinctive consistent design: straight cylindrical body with very subtly rounded bottom corners, thick gently rounded rim, a single generous rounded D-shaped handle on the right, softly glossy smooth sage-green glaze with extremely subtle ceramic microtexture, matching sage green interior, no contrasting unglazed foot. Three-quarter view from slightly above so the oval rim and interior are visible, mug upright, entire mug and handle visible, centered filling 70 percent of square. Empty mug. Seamless pure white #FFFFFF background and white surface with only a delicate realistic contact shadow. Soft large-window studio lighting from upper left, true-to-life muted sage green, realistic ceramic reflections, crisp detailed product photography, 85mm lens appearance. No props, no other mugs, no lettering, no borders, no collage.
